name: Mother Dairy Toned Milk
notes: Mother Dairy Pasteurised Toned Milk (min 3.0% fat, min 8.5% SNF, 127mg calcium per 100ml). Source: Official packaging nutrition label.

name: Harvest Gold Brown Bread
notes: Harvest Gold Hearty Brown Bread (30% whole wheat atta, 0.96g fat, 3.5g fibre per 100g; ~61 kcal per 28g slice). Source: Official packaging nutrition label.

name: Yogabar High Protein Oats (Dark Chocolate)
notes: Yogabar Dark Chocolate High Protein Oats (rolled oats with soy protein isolate and whey; 13g protein per 50g scoop, 0g added sugar). Source: Official packaging nutrition label.

name: AS-IT-IS Soy Protein Isolate (Unflavored)
notes: AS-IT-IS Nutrition 90% Soy Protein Isolate unflavoured (30g protein, 132 kcal, 0.48g fat per 35g scoop). Source: Official packaging nutrition label.

name: Milky Mist High Protein Paneer
notes: Milky Mist High Protein Paneer (25g protein, 7g fat, 529mg calcium per 100g; 50g protein per 200g pack). Source: Official packaging nutrition label.

name: Soya Chunks (dry)
notes: Defatted soya chunks dry weight. Source: Brand nutrition labels (Fortune & Nutrela average) and ICMR-NIN IFCT defatted soy flour.

name: Sugar (white, granulated)
notes: Refined cane white granulated sugar (99.8% sucrose). Source: USDA FoodData Central (FDC ID 169655) & ICMR-NIN IFCT 2017.

name: Rajma (cooked / boiled kidney beans)
notes: Plain boiled/pressure-cooked red kidney beans without added oil or gravy. Source: Averaged from USDA FoodData Central (FDC ID 173735), ICMR-NIN IFCT 2017 hydration conversion, and UK CoFID.

name: White Rice (cooked / steamed)
notes: Steamed/boiled long-grain white rice cooked without added oil or salt. Source: Averaged from USDA FoodData Central (FDC ID 168878), ICMR-NIN IFCT 2017, and UK McCance & Widdowson (CoFID).

name: Chapati (plain whole wheat roti, cooked)
notes: Traditional Indian whole wheat flatbread made from 100% atta, dry-roasted on tawa without added oil or ghee (~100 kcal per medium 40g roti). Source: Averaged from ICMR-NIN IFCT 2017, USDA FoodData Central, and NIN research publications.
